name: Ren'ai Kyoushitsu
source:
Standing outside of the classroom, the protagonist took a deep breath and calmed his nerves. Once he summoned the courage to open the door, he was immediately surrounded by girls in the class who treated him like a rare animal. That is natural since this had been an all-girls school until last year. However, not all the students were receptive of having a boy in their class. There were three groups: those for the co-ed change, those against it, and those whose views were in between. He has yet to get used to his new life in this new classroom with new friends, but he felt that his future is full of possibilities.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/06/01/june-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
站在教室外，主角深吸了一口气，平复了一下紧张的情绪。当他鼓起勇气打开门时，立刻就被班里的女生围住了，对待他就像对待珍稀动物一样。这是很自然的，因为直到去年这都是一所女子学校。然而，并非所有学生都接受班上有一个男孩。共有三类人：支持男女混合改革的人、反对混合教育的人和持介于两者之间的人。他还没有适应这个新教室和新朋友的新生活，但他觉得自己的未来充满了可能性。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/06/01/june-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
